About this item

  • 4-Blade Floating Precision: Engineered with 4 independent floating blades, the foil shavers for men contour to the jaw, chin, and neck in a single pass, capturing flat-lying hairs that fixed-heads miss. Each flexes for consistent skin contact
  • IPX7 Waterproof: The shaver is perfectly at home in a steamy shower or on a bathroom counter. Designed as a versatile electric razor for men, the unit transitions effortlessly between wet and dry use, and the sealed body rinses clean under running water
  • Compact Travel Ready: Charging via the universal USB-C port - One cable powers the shaver alongside phones and laptops. The palm-sized body fits a toiletry bag or carry-on. Your mini electric shaver includes a protective cap that shields for transit
  • LED Display & Dual Speed: A built-in LED screen displays remaining battery level at a glance, preventing mid-shave power loss. This electric shaver paired with 2 selectable speed modes, the lower for sensitive skin, while the higher for thicker growth
  • Thoughtful Gift Grooming Essential: This electric razor ready to use straight from the box with intuitive one-button operation. The compact make it a practical choice for birthdays or Father's Day, delivered as a thoughtful self-contained solution

      I've owned every major major brand face shaver in my 87th year on this planet, some good most not so. The one I used and liked the longest is the Braun Series 7. I've learned over the years that finding GOOD replacement heads for the Series 7 and surprisingly the Series 9 has been a real challenge. While looking recently for replacement heads I came upon an add for this shaver. It has a small form factor that I have been wanting to try and the price was about the same as replacement Braun heads, so I succumbed to the temptation!

      I've had it about a week and so far I've been favorably impressed. I really like the fit in my hand and the overall small form factor. It's easy to shave with and I'm pleased with the results. It's as good as my Braun, and I feel will even better when I have more experience with it. I also like the little speed boost that it has for some harder areas to shave. And, it's easier to clean than any other shaver I've owned. Why only 4 stars? The website question about replacement blades indicate no current availability. I'll be researching this more to verify the truth. If the blades last longer, it may end up being a non-factor, assuming the price remains the same.

    About this Item

    • 4-Blade Floating Precision: Engineered with 4 independent floating blades, the foil shavers for men contour to the jaw, chin, and neck in a single pass, capturing flat-lying hairs that fixed-heads miss. Each flexes for consistent skin contact
    • IPX7 Waterproof: The shaver is perfectly at home in a steamy shower or on a bathroom counter. Designed as a versatile electric razor for men, the unit transitions effortlessly between wet and dry use, and the sealed body rinses clean under running water
    • Compact Travel Ready: Charging via the universal USB-C port - One cable powers the shaver alongside phones and laptops. The palm-sized body fits a toiletry bag or carry-on. Your mini electric shaver includes a protective cap that shields for transit
    • LED Display & Dual Speed: A built-in LED screen displays remaining battery level at a glance, preventing mid-shave power loss. This electric shaver paired with 2 selectable speed modes, the lower for sensitive skin, while the higher for thicker growth
    • Thoughtful Gift Grooming Essential: This electric razor ready to use straight from the box with intuitive one-button operation. The compact make it a practical choice for birthdays or Father's Day, delivered as a thoughtful self-contained solution

    Product Description

    Picture yourself packing for a week-long business trip. Your suitcase is already full, but your grooming bag still needs a reliable shaver that won't take up space or require a bulky adapter. The foil shaver solves that. With 4 independent floating blades and a compact body, it delivers a close, comfortable shave whether you're in a hotel bathroom or rushing through your morning routine at home. On the road, every inch of luggage space matters. The shaver fits easily into any toiletry bag or carry-on without adding bulk. The USB-C port lets you recharge from a laptop or power bank — no dedicated adapter needed. The LED display shows remaining charge at a glance, so you can check battery status before any important meeting. Back home, your morning routine stays just as smooth. Choose low speed for precise detailing along the jawline, or switch to high speed for a quick full-face shave. The 4 floating blades flex independently to follow your facial contours, reducing missed patches and the need for repeated passes. After the gym, the IPX7 waterproof rating means you can use the shaver in the shower with foam or gel for a closer wet shave. Rinse it clean under running water in seconds. The protective blade cap keeps the foil safe in your gym bag, maintaining cutting performance over time. Technical Highlights: 4 Floating Blades: Independent flex covers chin, jaw, and neck in fewer passes 2 Speed Settings: Low for precision detailing, high for efficient full-face shaving IPX7 Waterproof: Safe shower use with foam or gel, rinse-clean under running water LED Battery Display: Real-time charge level at a glance, no unexpected shutdowns USB-C Charging: Compatible with laptops, power banks, and modern chargers Whether traveling for work, grooming at home, or heading to the gym, the shaver adapts to your lifestyle. Includes shaver, USB-C cable, and protective blade cap — complete and ready to use right out of the box. A practical gift for birthdays, Father's Day, or any occasion.
